question.prompt: Given \(a\parallel b\), line \(c\) intersects \(a\) and \(b\). Angles \(\angle 1\) and \(\angle 2\) are same-side interior angles, with \(\angle 1=2x+20^\circ\) and \(\angle 2=3x-10^\circ\). Find the measure of \(\angle 1\) in degrees.

solutions.explanation: Same-side interior angles are supplementary: \(2x+20+3x-10=180\), so \(x=34\) and \(\angle 1=2\times34+20=88^\circ\).
solutions.title: Supplementary-angle equation
